items.reason: Refers to 'the replacement' and 'that one' without saying which order or item.
'it had a plant in it' refers to an unstated order or package, and 'ok' follows an earlier answer.
'one' is an unstated thing already submitted, such as a claim or request.
Chasing an unspecified issue for the third time. An agent can't tell what the issue is.
'the same plant again' refers to a plant from an earlier order or issue that isn't named.
